prompt: Cozy evening study desk, filmed for real. Vertical 9:16, 50mm, shallow depth of field, warm table-lamp light from the upper left, deep plum-purple shadows, soft natural film grain. An open paper notebook with faint ruled lines on a warm wooden desk, a plain yellow wooden pencil with a pink eraser, and a plain persimmon-orange ceramic mug of tea with no logo or print. One hand only, a young adult's, relaxed and natural with five fingers. No face, no screens, no readable words, no logos, no reflections, no extra objects. Locked-off camera, no zoom.

multi_prompt.prompt: Close, slightly high angle on the top of a blank notebook page, the pencil tip in the centre of the frame. A hand holding the yellow pencil hesitates just above the page, then writes one short, slightly uneven first line of loose illegible handwriting and carries on into the next line. Most of the page stays blank. Locked-off camera.

Same desk, same notebook and warm lamp light, a little wider: a few lines of loose illegible handwriting near the top of the page, most of the page still blank. The hand lays the yellow pencil down on the page, then reaches to the orange mug beside the notebook and curls its fingers around the handle as a thin wisp of steam rises. Locked-off camera.
